sentences.text: Peter Dougan Capaldi -LRB- born 14 April 1958 -RRB- is a Scottish actor , writer and director , best known for playing the twelfth incarnation of the Doctor in the television series Doctor Who .	twelfth incarnation of the Doctor	Twelfth Doctor	Doctor Who	Doctor Who

His next most notable role is spin doctor Malcolm Tucker in The Thick of It , for which he has received four British Academy Television Award nominations , winning Best Male Comedy Performance in 2010 .	spin doctor	spin doctor	Malcolm Tucker	Malcolm Tucker	The Thick of It	The Thick of It	British Academy Television Award	British Academy Television Award	Best Male Comedy Performance	British Academy Television Award for Best Male Comedy Performance
For reprising the role in the spinoff film In the Loop , Capaldi was honoured with several film critic award nominations for Best Supporting Actor .	In the Loop	In the Loop (film)

He further took on the role of Paddington Bear 's neighbour Mr. Curry in the family comedy film Paddington ; he is set to reprise the role in Paddington 2 .	Paddington Bear	Paddington Bear	Paddington	Paddington (film)	Paddington 2	Paddington 2

As a director , Capaldi won the Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film and the BAFTA Award for Best Short Film for his short film Franz Kafka 's It 's a Wonderful Life .	Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film	Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film	BAFTA Award for Best Short Film	BAFTA Award for Best Short Film
He went on to write and direct the drama film Strictly Sinatra and helmed two series of sitcom Getting On .	Strictly Sinatra	Strictly Sinatra	Getting On	Getting On (UK TV series)
